sourceLines.code:
n = int(input())
line = input()

line = list(map(int, line.split()))

m = 0
for i in range(1, n):
    suml = sum(line[:i])
    sumr = sum(line[i:])
    if abs(suml - sumr) > 10000:
        continue
    if suml == sumr:
        m += 1
print(m)

counterexample.mathematicalDerivation: The nine stripe values sum to zero; equal halves require a proper prefix sum of zero. Proper zero prefixes occur only after positions 3,6,7, so there are exactly three legal cuts. The source counts the always-zero FULL prefix after position 9 as a fourth illegal cut.
